initial.title: Authorize print collection
initial.notesBody:
Keep this collection reference available when you arrive. The counter team will check the job number before handing over the sealed cartons.

The programmes are packed flat in three reusable cartons. Please bring a trolley or ask the counter team for help before moving the full order to your vehicle.

If someone collects for you, they must show their own photo ID and quote the same collection reference. This authorization covers collection only; it does not allow changes to artwork, quantities, or payment details.

Check the carton labels before leaving. If a carton looks damaged or a quantity differs from the packing slip, keep it at the counter so the team can record the issue with you.

Uncollected print work is stored indoors for seven calendar days. Contact the shop before the end of that period if your event has moved, because bulky orders may require a new collection arrangement.

updates.notesBody: Bring a vehicle that can carry two boards measuring 70 × 100 cm. The boards must travel upright, secured against movement, and protected from rain. Ask the oversize desk for a protective sleeve before leaving.
